description: Agent Grants: submit spending records under a grant with the approved budget: the records with the grant, the currency and each expense with its id, budget category, amount, the day spent and whether it was paid from matching funds rather than the grant; the approved budget with the grant, the currency, the first and last day of the grant period, each category with the amount approved for it and the matching spend required. The signed report gives the records and the approved budget, each grant-funded expense totalled under its budget category against the amount approved, every expense in an unbudgeted category or outside the grant period named, and the matching spend against the requirement, and counts them, and names a divergent record set: another currency, an expense in a category the approved budget does not hold, an expense outside the grant period, a category above its approved amount and matching spend below the requirement; then two expenses with one category, amount and day, and another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Expenses with no category or day where the budget states categories or a period, a matching requirement with no expense marked as matching or grant-funded, or a budget that states none of these leaves the records unverified. Expenses total under the category the budget names for them by their words with plurals folded, grant-funded and matching spend kept apart, amounts compare to the cent in one currency and days read against the grant period with its first and last day included. This returns a verdict on grant spending against the approved grant budget: wever_expense-close-pack assembles a closing pack from one period’s payment, receipt and refund records and returns no verdict, while the expense check assembles no pack; and wever_spend-category-brief totals one period of transactions by category and counterparty, while the expense check reads each expense against the categories, caps, period and match the approved budget sets. Verdict grant_expense_divergent, grant_expense_partial, grant_expense_unverified or grant_expense_consistent. POST /api/grant-expense-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
